overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures spray dried raspberry powder for industrial food processing. We process ripe raspberries using advanced spray drying technology to create a free-flowing, fine powder. The rapid moisture removal maintains vibrant color, natural aroma, and rich flavor. As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter from India, we deliver consistent quality for international production lines.

Our powder offers high solubility and uniform particle size for easy formulation in food systems. We manage a strict six-step manufacturing process from raw material sourcing to packing and dispatch. We support global buyers with bulk supply, OEM private labeling, and custom packaging. Every order includes export documentation support to streamline smooth international shipments.
highlights: Fine particle profile sieved to 80-100 mesh.
Rapid solubility in water and beverage formulations.
Stable shelf life of 12 to 18 months.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg. We support pilot tests and commercial bulk shipments.

faqs.q: Do you provide custom mesh sizes and packaging?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer custom mesh specifications along with tailored packaging configurations on request.

faqs.q: Can I request product samples before placing an order?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide product samples upon request to assist your formulation and testing needs.

faqs.q: What private label and OEM services are available?
faqs.a: We offer complete OEM and private labeling, packing powder into custom pouches and jars.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life and recommended storage condition?
faqs.a: The shelf life is 12 to 18 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you provide export documentation support?
faqs.a: Yes. As an IEC-registered exporter, we offer complete export documentation support for customs clearance.
